session_start.label: SessionStart
session_start.note: AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md and every skill description load here

prompt.label: UserPromptSubmit
prompt.note: Slash commands expand; the model picks skills by description

pre_tool.label: PreToolUse
pre_tool.note: Gates run before every tool call

permission.label: PermissionRequest
permission.note: An ask from a hook becomes a prompt; bypass mode denies instead

tool.label: [tool executes]
tool.note: Bash, Edit, MCP, Skill, Agent, Workflow

post_batch.label: PostToolBatch
post_batch.note: After a batch of parallel calls

stop.label: Stop / StopFailure
stop.note: The turn ends: the place to prove done

pre_compact.label: PreCompact
pre_compact.note: Context is about to be summarized

session_end.label: SessionEnd
session_end.note: Session closes; resumed sessions start again

harness-map.when: Setup audit: what is installed, missing or failing, as one HTML page

project-init.when: Repo has no agent block yet, or a doctor run

environments.when: Before any deploy, SSH, migration or remote data access

worktree-flow.when: Before the first file change (own worktree) and when finishing (PR into the integration branch)

feature-build.when: /feature-build or a user story to implement

bug-triage.when: /bug-triage or a bug or QA ticket

fe-guardrails.when: Before writing React or Next.js screens, forms and error states

ask-or-decide.when: Before an AskUserQuestion call or a scope change

axi.when: While building a CLI that agents will call

server-touch.when: Before a Bash call that touches a live Docker Compose host

root-cause.when: A test, build or deploy fails, or a fix did not work

chrome-devtools-axi.when: The browser driver behind e2e-verify when Playwright MCP is absent

e2e-verify.when: Before calling a user-facing change done: browser evidence per AC

flow-trace.when: Before done on state machines, webhooks, jobs, money, access gates

security-pass.when: Before done when the diff hits auth, tenant data, SQL, storage, env

fresh-review.when: Before a PR: a fresh subagent reviews the diff until clean

gnhf.when: /gnhf overnight loop of small committed changes

stow.when: Before a context reset or a break: save what was learned

knowledge-placement.when: Before editing AGENTS.md or a skill; red/green skill tests use fresh subagents
